label: rem:confinement-category-invertibility
title: Invertibility of the morphisms of $\mathbf{Conf}$
html: In the confinement category, unfolding and folding are mutually inverse when restricted to particles whose coarse representation captures the full partition content. The morphism \mathrm{dress} is generally not invertible because the binding subword may not be uniquely reversible.
heading: Remark
